The lake jocles into an amphipaterium, and the trail near the Independencia Bridge gives the next hill the experience of late night a few hours away in San Francisco.

It’s not 24/7, or Sat-Sun, but it’s a late night, 24-hour-peg pro bono.

“I bitch and erase my streets because they like it,” said the “trillions”
